text: ぼうそうぞくの　＊が　しょうぶを　しかけてきた！
note: ぼうそうぞく (bōsōzoku) are real Japanese youth motorcycle gangs, known for loud modified bikes and reckless group riding. The word is much rougher than the English "Biker".
claim: Bōsōzoku is a Japanese youth subculture of motorcycle gangs who ride loud, illegally modified bikes.

check.quote: Bōsōzoku (暴走族, lit. 'reckless driving group') is a Japanese youth subculture associated with customized motorcycles. [...] an interest in motorcycle customizing, often illegal, and making noise by removing the mufflers on their vehicles so that more noise is produced. [...] also engage in dangerous or reckless driving, such as weaving in traffic, and running red lights.
